major_concerns: Verifier–agent interface is underspecified (message/API format, timing, error semantics) and may bias outcomes if hand-tuned.
Emulator/testbed realism risk: results may overfit to the chosen synthetic/emulated topology and not generalize to production networks.
Missing pre-registered power/sample-size justification and explicit LLM/model identifiers (version, temperature, API) and seeds.
Potential for implementation choices (e.g., feedback intensity, beam/pruning policies) to drive results rather than the co-design principle.
required_design_repairs: Specify exact verifier implementation or API (e.g., Batfish/NetKAT or custom) and formally define the verifier feedback primitives (constraints, counterexamples, pruning signals).
Provide full emulator/testbed specification, task corpus generation scripts, and justify ecological validity; include at least two topology classes to reduce overfitting.
Pre-register sample-size/power calculation, exact LLM model identifiers and hyperparameters, random seeds, and retry policy.
Predefine feedback-intensity ablation levels and their deterministic implementations; log all verifier-planner exchanges and publish trace corpus for reproducibility.

major_concerns: Adversarial/noise injection procedures are underspecified and may not reflect realistic retrieval corruption modes.
Retrieval stack (engine, embeddings, index parameters) is not fully specified; different retrieval implementations could change results substantially.
Corpus construction and provenance of synthetic state snapshots must be reproducible to avoid unintentional leakage or bias.
Statistical analysis plan (mixed-effects model) needs specification of random effects structure and correction for multiple contrasts.
required_design_repairs: Define retrieval stack precisely (retriever type, embedding model/version, index settings) and supply reproducible indexing scripts and artifact hashes.
Provide deterministic, documented procedures to generate (a) random-noise and (b) adversarial-noise retrieval conditions, including seeds and adversary heuristics; release adversarial generator code.
Pre-register corpus sources, curation filters, and forensic logging for retrieved passages; include a held-out validation set to check overfitting.
Specify mixed-effects model formula, random-effects terms, planned contrasts, and multiple-comparison correction procedures in the preregistration; include power analysis for interaction effects.

major_concerns: Human-reviewer simulation is central but current design lacks validation against real reviewer behavior; results may not transfer if simulator is miscalibrated.
Ethical/external-validity risk if simulation-driven conclusions are extrapolated to real operators without human-subject data or careful caveats.
Reviewer fatigue model and decision-policy parameters are underspecified; outcomes may be highly sensitive to these choices.
Operational cost and workload modeling needs clearer metrics and sensitivity analysis.
required_design_repairs: Provide calibration sources and validation for the human-reviewer simulator (public datasets, prior studies) and report fit/limitations of the simulator.
Pre-register reviewer decision policy (signal inputs, thresholds), fatigue model, and sensitivity ranges; include robustness checks across plausible parameter sweeps.
Add conservative reporting language and limit extrapolation to production; include plan for future human-subject calibration rather than claiming transferability.
Define cost-effectiveness metrics clearly (unsafe changes avoided per human-hour) and pre-register thresholds for operationally meaningful differences.

major_concerns: Constrained-decoding grammars and repair heuristics may be hand-tuned to the task corpus and bias results toward constrained methods.
CoT prompt templates, length/temperature settings, and decoding hyperparameters are not fully specified; CoT benefits may be model- and prompt-sensitive.
Repair-module determinism and oracle access assumptions need clarification (does repair use the verifier or a separate model?).
Primary outcome (trade-off curve) requires clear, pre-registered operationalization of 'semantic correctness' and the joint-success criterion.
required_design_repairs: Publish grammar files, parsing/decoder implementation, and automated scripts used to generate constrained outputs; ensure grammars are developed blind to test set.
Pre-register CoT prompt templates, generation hyperparameters, and deterministic repair algorithm; specify whether repair uses only syntactic rules or verifier feedback.
Clarify repair-module inputs/outputs and dependency on additional models or the verifier; make repair code deterministic and releaseable.
Operationalize semantic-correctness and joint-success metrics in the preregistration and provide thresholds and rationale for area-under-curve summarization.
